# Story 01 — Notifications inbox screen for staff (Story: CRM-117)

## Prerequisites

-
**NOTIFICATIONS-1-API** must be shipped before this can run end-to-end. This story consumes the `GET /api/notifications`
, `GET /api/notifications/unread-count`, and `POST /api/notifications/:id/read` endpoints owned by `NOTIFICATIONS-2-API (CRM-116)`. Confirm the exact request/response shape with that

story's author before wiring the hook; do **not** add or change any `api/` code here.
- Web
session hook (`web/src/shared/session/use-me.ts`) and the desk shell (`web/src/app/desk-shell/DeskShell.tsx`) already exist and gate on

`isStaff`/`isAdmin`.
- The four-state `useRequest` hook (`web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.ts`) is the pattern for reads; local
`useState` is the pattern for a list the screen mutates in place (see `TicketCategoriesPage`, `PortalTicketP

age`).

---

## Story Goal

Give a signed-in staff member a place — the **Notifications** page — to read their notifications and a shell indicator that tells them, from

wherever they are on the desk, how many are unread.

User-visible outcomes:

1. The desk shell shows an unread badge next to a **Notifications** link when

ever the count is `> 0`, and shows no badge (not "0") when there are none.
2. A `/notifications` route renders a paginated,

chronological list. Each row states what happened and which ticket it was about, and is one click away from the ticket.
3. Opening the list does **not** m
ark anything read. Reading is deliberate: a per-row "Mark read" action calls the API and, using the response, updates the visible list and the shell count

without any refetch or reload.
4. When there are none at all, the screen says so (empty state) r

ather than rendering an empty frame; the shell shows no count.
5. Every string comes from the i18n resource files (**BR-6**, both `en` and `ar`); every tim

estamp is formatted through `useFormatters` (**BR-3**).

**Out of scope:** any `api/` change (owned by CRM-116); live updates, polling, W

ebSocket subscriptions; per-notification unread filters beyond what the API already supports; grouping/threading.

---

## Context — Read These

Files First

1. `web/src/app/desk-shell/DeskShell.tsx` — the entire file. Note the import of `useMe` (line 7) and the `const { isAdmin, isStaff } = useMe()` call
(line 21). All nav links are drawn conditionally on those flags, which are `undefined` until `/me` answers. **Nothing role-dependent may

render on `undefined`** — new badge/link included.
2. `web/src/app/desk-shell/DeskShell.test.tsx` — the current tests for conditional rendering. New tests for the bad

ge and link go beside them.
3. `web/src/shared/session/use-me.ts` — see how `useMe()` returns `{ me, isStaff, isAdmin

, ... }` (export at line 31). The notifications count will live outside this hook; do **not** widen `useMe`.
4. `web/src/app
/routes.tsx` — the router table. Add the new `/notifications` route beside the other staff-only routes; wrap in `RequireAuth`/

staff gate the same way `TicketQueuePage` and `AuditLogPage` are wrapped.
5. `web/src/pages/tickets/TicketQ
ueuePage.tsx` (line 336 uses `useMe`) and `web/src/pages/tickets/useTicketQueue.ts` — the reference for a
paginated, filterable, sortable list that owns its own filter state and pager and re-f

etches via `useRequest`.
6. `web/src/pages/tickets/TicketCategoriesPage.tsx` and `web/src/pages/portal/PortalTicketPage.tsx` — the reference for a screen that
holds a mutable local copy of the list returned by `useRequest`, so a write's response can update the row in place without a refetch. `useRequest` **

holds one answer with no setter**; follow their pattern.
7. `web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.ts` and `web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.test.ts` — the four states (
`idle | loading | ok | error`). Confirm the exact API of `run()`/`data`/`error` before writing the

hook wrappers.
8. `web/src/shared/api/client.ts` — the `apiClient` methods for `GET`/`POST` (see `useTicketThread.ts`, `useRe

ply.ts` for typical call sites).
9. `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts` and `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts` — where to add every user-vis

ible string. `web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.ts` enforces both files carry the same keys.
10. `web/src/shared/i18n/useFormatters.ts` — the locale-aware date

/time formatter (**BR-3**). Use it for the "when" column.
11. `web/src/pages/tickets/ticket-labels.ts` and
`web/src/pages/tickets/history-sentence.ts` — the reference for resolving an id-carrying row into a readable label from the reader's locale. A

notification row carries a **ticket id and no subject** — resolving it is the screen's job.
12. `web/src/shared/ui/index.ts` — the primitives (
`Button`, `Card`, `Stack`, `EmptyState`, `ErrorState`, `Skeleton`, `Heading`, `Text`) new UI must reuse. Do

**not** hand-roll.
13. `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` — enforces all page strings come from i18n. New pages are

covered automatically.
14. `web/src/testing/render.tsx` and `web/src/testing/stub-me.ts` — how to render a screen inside providers with

a fake `/me` and mocked API in tests.
15. `scripts/criteria/notifications.md`, section **NOTIFICATIONS-2-WEB** — the acceptance criteria transcribed in

the intake; the exact rows on the checklist below.
16. `.squad/plan-lessons.md` — read once before starting; every "one
rule per defect" item that touches web pages, i18n parity, `useMe` undefined-flash, or hardcoded strings appl

ies here.
17. `docs/taxonomy.md` — for naming; the screen is **Notifications**, the badge/count is **unread count**. No new

names.
18. `docs/architecture.md` — where web code goes: page under `web/src/pages/notifications/`, hooks colocated, shared U

match one for shape.
- `grep -R "unread" web/src` — should return nothing today; conf

irm no clash on new keys.
- `grep -R "/notifications" web/src` — confirm no existing route with that path.

---

## Product rules (from story
behaviour:** The shell shows a **Notifications** nav link with an unread-count badge (hidden when count is 0 or unknown). The `/notifications` route lists notifications with a per-row "Mark read"

action and a "1 unread" / "None unread" summary. Opening the list marks nothing.

Rule this story owns: **BR-
4 — No unbounded list: paginated, filterable, sortable, with a maximum page size.** The list must use the API's pagination; the page never asks for more than the API's max

page size and always shows a pager control when there is a next page.

---

## Frontend Tasks

### 1 — Notifications count context

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/notifications/useUnreadCount.ts`

- Small hook that owns the current unread count in module-
level state (a tiny React context or Zustand-less pattern using `useSyncExternalStore` — match whatever `
auth-context.tsx` and `theme-context.tsx` already do; prefer a `React.createContext` provider mounted once in `App

.tsx`).
- Exposes `{ count, setCount, refresh }`. Initial value is `undefined` (not `0`) so the shell can dist

inguish "unknown" from "zero" and not flash a `0` badge before `/me` resolves.
- `refresh()` calls `GET /api/notifications/unread-count` through `apiClient` and st
ores `count` (a non-negative integer). Only called from the provider effect on mount **after** `useMe()` reports `isStaff === true`; do

**not** call it when `isStaff` is `undefined` or `false`.
- `setCount(n)` is what the screen calls after a "Mark read" write returns the new count.

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/notifications/

unread-count-context.tsx`

- Standard `createContext<UnreadCountValue | null>(null)` + `useContext` throw
-on-missing pattern, mirroring `web/src/app/auth-context.tsx`. Wraps children with a provider that runs the effect above

.

**Edit file:** `web/src/app/App.tsx`

- Mount `<UnreadCountProvider>` inside `<AuthProvider>` and around the router. Do **not** mount it above

`AuthProvider` — it depends on `useMe()`.

### 2 — Shell nav entry with unread badge

**Edit file:** `web/src/app/desk-shell/

DeskShell.tsx`

- Import `useUnreadCount` from `web/src/pages/notifications/unread-count-context`.
- Add a new nav entry **"Notifications"** in the staff section (

guarded by `isStaff === true`, matching the existing pattern — never on `undefined`). Link target `/notifications`.
- Render the badge only when `typeof count === 'number'

&& count > 0`. Badge text is the raw integer formatted through `useFormatters` (locale digits).
- **Accessibility:
** badge has `aria-label` from i18n key `notifications.badge.aria` (`"{count} unread notifications"` in en, matching Arabic pl

ural rules).
- No new CSS file; extend `DeskShell.css` with a `.desk-shell__badge` class using existing token vari

ables from `tokens.css`.

**Edit file:** `web/src/app/desk-shell/DeskShell.test.tsx`

- Add cases:
  - When `isStaff` is `

undefined`, the Notifications link is **not** rendered.
  - When `isStaff` is `true` and count is `undefined`, the link renders **without** a badge.
  - When count is `0`, the link renders **without** a badge (

not "0").
  - When count is `3`, the link renders with badge text `3` and the expected `aria-label`.
  - When count is `1`, the aria-label uses the singular form from `

en.ts`.

### 3 — Route wiring

**Edit file:** `web/src/app/routes.tsx`

- Add `/notifications` → `<NotificationsPage />`, wrapped by the same staff gate the

ticket queue uses. Lazy-load if the sibling routes lazy-load; otherwise import directly to match style.

**Edit file:** `web

/src/app/routing.test.tsx`

- Add cases:
  - A signed-in staff user navigating to `/notifications` sees the page heading.
  - A signed-in non-staff user navigating to

`/notifications` is bounced the same way non-staff hitting `/tickets` are today.
  - An an

onymous request to `/notifications` is bounced to sign-in.

### 4 — Notifications page

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/notifications/NotificationsPage.tsx`

- Page-level component.
Uses `useRequest` to load the first page via `useNotificationsList` (below); holds the returned list in **local `useState<Notification[]>`** seeded from the request
's `data` on success. The seed happens in an effect keyed on the request result's identity (mirror the pattern in `TicketCategories

Page.tsx`).
- **Filters/sort/pagination:**
  - Sort: newest first (default). Provide a `<Select>` to toggle "
Unread only" / "All" if the API supports it — check with CRM-116 first; if not present, omit the filter and note it in `

Edge Cases`.
  - Pager: "Older" / "Newer" buttons, disabled at ends; page size is the API's default
(do not override). Enforce **BR-4** by never sending a `pageSize` above the API

's documented maximum.
- **Row shape:** each row shows action verb (from i18n key per notification `kind`), the resolved ticket label (`#
123 — <subject>` via a lookup, see below), and a locale-formatted rel

ative time.
- **Ticket-id resolution:** notification carries a ticket id and no subject. Collect the distinct ticket ids from the current page and load their labels through
the same shape `useTicketQueue` returns — reuse an existing hook if one exists (`grep -R "use
TicketLabels" web/src` first); otherwise add a small `useTicketLabels(ids)` in `web/src/pages/notifications/useTicketLabels.
ts` that calls the ticket read endpoint the desk already uses. **Do not** invent a new API. If
no batched lookup exists, render `#{id}` as the fallback label and file the follow-up in a

code comment referencing CRM-117.
- **"Mark read" action:** per-row `<Button>`; disabled while pending; on success:
  -

Replace the row in local list state with the returned notification (now `readAt` set).
  - Call `setCount(response
.unreadCount)` on the context so the shell badge updates without a refetch. **Do not** call `refresh()` — the write already told us

.
  - If the response does not carry `unreadCount`, decrement the current count locally by 1 (never below 0) and open a com

ment ticket back to CRM-116.
- **States:**
  - `loading` → `<Skeleton />` rows.
  - `error` → `<ErrorState />` with a "Try again" button that

re-runs the request.
  - `ok && list.length === 0` → `<EmptyState />` with i18n key `notifications.empty.title` / `notifications.empty.

body`.
- All copy from i18n; all times through `useFormatters`.

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/notifications/useNotificationsList.ts`

-

Wraps `useRequest` for `GET /api/notifications?page=<n>&pageSize=<n>&filter=<...>`.
- Exposes `{ state, data, error, load

, next, prev, page, hasNext, hasPrev }`.

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/notifications/useMarkNotificationRead.ts`

- Wraps `useRequest` for `POST /api/notifications/:id/read`.
- Exposes `{ mark, pending, error }`; `mark(id)` returns the response so

the page can splice the row and update the context count.

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/notifications/NotificationsPage.css`

- Row grid lay
out using existing tokens; no colour literals. Follow `TicketHistory.css` for a comparable list lay

out.

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/notifications/index.ts`

- Barrel re-export of `NotificationsPage` and the context provider.

### 5 — i18n strings

**Edit files:** `web/src/shared/i18n/en.

ts` and `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts`

Add matching keys in both:

- `notifications.nav.label` — "Notifications" / Arabic equ

ivalent.
- `notifications.badge.aria` — pluralised "{count} unread notifications".
- `notifications.page.title` — "Notifications".
- `notifications.page.summary.none` — "None unread".
- `notif

ications.page.summary.some` — "{count} unread".
- `notifications.filter.label`, `.all`, `.unread-only` — filter control (only if API supports).
- `notifications.row.action.<kind>` — one key per notification `kind` the API defines (confirm the exact set with CRM-116; start with the k

inds the notifications feature seeds).
- `notifications.row.mark-read` — "Mark read".
- `notifications.row.marked-read` — status label when already read (row still visible on

"All" filter).
- `notifications.row.ticket-link.aria` — "Open ticket {label}".
- `notifications.empty.title` and `.body` — empty-state cop

y.
- `notifications.error.title` / `.retry` — error-state copy.
- `notifications.pager.older` / `.newer` — pager labels.

`web/src/shared/i

18n/parity.test.ts` will fail if any key exists on only one side — that is the guard.

---

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **`/me` not yet
resolved:** `isStaff` is `undefined`. Nav link and provider effect both hold off; no badge is drawn. Enforced in `D

eskShell.tsx` guard and `useUnreadCount` effect.
- **Non-staff user:** provider does not fetch; `<NotificationsP

age />` is gated by the route guard in `routes.tsx` and never mounts.
- **Count is 0:** shell renders link with no badge (not "0"). Page

shows `<EmptyState />`. Enforced in `DeskShell.tsx` badge condition and in `NotificationsPage.tsx` empty branch.
- **Tic
ket id resolves to a deleted/inaccessible ticket:** row shows `#{id}` fallback label and a disabled link with tooltip from `

notifications.row.unresolved` i18n key. Mark-read still works.
- **Concurrent "Mark read" clicks:** each row's button is disabled while its `useR
equest` is pending; the context count update uses the server's response value, so out-of-order writes converge on the last response.
- **API returns a page whose ids are stale after a mark-read splice:** the local list is authoritative until `load()` run

s again; pager navigation always reloads from the server.
- **Unicode / RTL:** the badge count uses `useFormatters` so
Arabic-Indic digits render in `ar`. Labels come from i18n; no mirrored styles (cov

ered by `no-mirrored-styles.test.ts`).
- **Empty state after last unread is marked:** if the current page has no rows after a mark-read splice AND we are

on page > 1 AND `hasPrev`, jump back one page. Otherwise show `<EmptyState />`.
- **API `unreadCount` field missing on write

response:** decrement locally by 1, floor at 0; add a comment referencing CRM-116 so the API side can add it.
- **Provider unm
ount / auth loss:** on `me` transitioning back to `null`, reset the count to `undefined

` (not `0`) so the next sign-in re-fetches cleanly.
- **BR-4 upper bound:** never send `pageSize` greater than what the API documents; the h

ook clamps.

---

## Test Plan

1. **`web/src/app/desk-shell/DeskShell.test.tsx`** — add the five cases in section 2 above (

undefined staff, staff+no-count, staff+zero, staff+3, singular aria-label at count=1).
2. **`web/src/app/routing.test.tsx`** —

add the three cases in section 3 (staff sees page, non-staff bounced, anon bounced).
3. **Create `web/src/pages/notifications/NotificationsPage.test.tsx`** covering:
   - loading sk

eleton renders,
   - empty state when list is `[]`,
   - error state + retry re-runs the request,
   - three-row happy path ren

ders resolved ticket labels and locale-formatted times,
   - clicking "Mark read" on a row: disables the button, splices the row (readAt set), and calls the context `

setCount` with the API's `unreadCount`,
   - opening the page does **not** call the mark-read endpoint (assert zero PO

STs to `/notifications/*/read`),
   - pager: "Older" and "Newer" call the list hook with the expected page number; dis

abled at boundaries.
4. **Create `web/src/pages/notifications/useUnreadCount.test.tsx`** covering:
   - initial value is `undefined`,
   - fetches only after

`isStaff === true`,
   - `setCount` updates all subscribers,
   - resets to `undefined` on sign-out.
5. **Create `web/src/pages/notifications/useNotificationsList.test.ts`** covering pagination cl

amping (BR-4) and error propagation.
6. **`web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.ts`** — passes automatically once both `en.ts` and `ar.

ts` carry the new keys; if it fails locally, fix the missing side before proceeding.
7. **`web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`** — passes automatically because all

page strings resolve via the `t()` helper; if it flags a literal, move it to i18n.
8. **`web/src/shared/i18n/no-mirrored-styles.test.ts`** — passes because no

CSS uses `transform: scaleX(-1)` or physical `left`/`right`.

Use `web/src/testing/render.tsx` and `web/src/testing/
stub-me.ts` to mount the page with a stubbed `/me` and a fetch-mock; follow the pattern in `TicketQueuePage.test.t

sx`.

---

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend runs:** from `web/`, run `npm test` — the new suites and the par

ity/hardcoded-string guards must pass.
2. **Frontend builds:** from `web/`, run `npm run build` (which is `tsc -b && vite build` — the only

web typecheck). Must pass with no errors.
3. **Backend regression:** none required in this story.

From `api/`, run `npm test` only if you touched anything in `api/` (you should not have).
4. **AI-attribution guard:** from rep
o root, run `git grep -nEi "co-authored-by:.*claude|co-authored-by:.*openai|generated by (ch
atgpt|claude|copilot)|assisted by ai"` — must return no matches in committed files, comm

its, or ignore files.
5. **Regression:** manual smoke — sign in as a staff member with unread notifications; bad
ge appears in the shell within one paint after `/me` resolves; navigate to `/notifications`; mark one read; the badge count decrements and the row

updates without a network refetch of the list; navigate away and back to confirm state matches the server.
6. **RTL sm
oke:** switch the app language to Arabic; badge digits render in Arabic-Indic form, layout mirrors, times are

in the reader's locale.

---

## Done Criteria

- [ ] Desk shell has a **Notifications** nav link, gated on `isStaff === true`, never rendered while

`isStaff` is `undefined`.
- [ ] Shell badge shows a positive integer only; hidden at 0 and at unknown.
- [ ] `/notifications` route exists, is sta

ff-gated, and is reachable from the shell link.
- [ ] Notifications page lists paginated rows with action verb, resolved ticket label, and locale-formatted time.
- [ ] Opening the list does not mark anything; a per-row action does, and updates the row + badge from the write's response with

no refetch.
- [ ] Empty state renders when there are none; shell shows no badge, not "0".
- [ ] Error state renders on failure with a working ret

ry.
- [ ] Every user-visible string is in `en.ts` and `ar.ts`; `parity.test.ts` passes.
- [ ] Every displ

ayed time is formatted through `useFormatters` (BR-3).
- [ ] List pagination honours the API's max page size (BR-4).
- [ ] No `api/` change committed.
- [ ]

`web` `npm test` and `npm run build` both green.
- [ ] AI-attribution grep is empty.
